definitions.gloss: antique art; old art objects; classical art
definitions.explanation: Art objects and crafts from earlier periods, including paintings, ceramics, sculptures, lacquerware, and other traditional items valued for their age and craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: {古美術|こびじゅつ}を{集|あつ}めている。
この{通|とお}りには{古美術|こびじゅつ}{店|てん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many antique art shops on this street.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}で{日本|にほん}の{古美術|こびじゅつ}を{鑑賞|かんしょう}する{旅|たび}に{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: I went on a trip to Kyoto to appreciate Japanese antique art.

notes:
FORMS:
{古|こ} (old, ancient) + {美術|びじゅつ} (fine art). Refers specifically to art objects of historical value.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古美術|こびじゅつ}{店|てん} (antique art shop)
- {古美術|こびじゅつ}{商|しょう} (antique art dealer)
- {古美術|こびじゅつ}の{鑑定|かんてい} (appraisal of antique art)
- {古美術|こびじゅつ}{品|ひん} (antique art objects)
- {日本|にほん}の{古美術|こびじゅつ} (Japanese antique art)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {骨董品|こっとうひん}: antiques — broader category including non-art items
- {美術品|びじゅつひん}: art objects — not restricted to old items
